name: college-chemistry
description: Track units through real chemical quantities.

interface.longDescription: Track units through real chemical quantities. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Calculate a formula mass; Convert a reactant mass to theoretical product; Calculate a dilution. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me calculate a formula mass.
Help me convert a reactant mass to theoretical product.

prompts: Help me calculate a formula mass.
Help me convert a reactant mass to theoretical product.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Mole Bench: Chemistry workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Calculate a formula mass. Reproducible inputs: {"formula":"Ca(OH)2"}
positive.prompt: Help me calculate a formula mass with these supplied values: {"formula":"Ca(OH)2"}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_chemistry_molar_mass with the supplied inputs. Returns {"formula":"Ca(OH)2","atoms":{"Ca":1,"O":2,"H":2},"molar_mass_g_per_mol":74.092,"contributions":[{"element":"Ca","count":1,"atomic_mass":40.078,"contribution":40.078},{"element":"O","count":2,"atomic_mass":15.999,"contribution":31.998},{"element":"H","count":2,"atomic_mass":1.008,"contribution":2.016}],"note":"Uses bundled conventional atomic masses; isotope labels and hydrate dot notation are unsupported."}. Shows the actual molecule result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Convert a reactant mass to theoretical product. Reproducible inputs: {"reactant_mass_g":10,"reactant_molar_mass":2.016,"reactant_coefficient":2,"product_molar_mass":18.015,"product_coefficient":2}
positive.prompt: Help me convert a reactant mass to theoretical product with these supplied values: {"reactant_mass_g":10,"reactant_molar_mass":2.016,"reactant_coefficient":2,"product_molar_mass":18.015,"product_coefficient":2}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_chemistry_stoichiometry with the supplied inputs. Returns {"reactant_moles":4.9603,"product_moles":4.9603,"theoretical_product_g":89.3601,"assumption":"Supplied equation is balanced and other reactants are in excess."}. Shows the actual reaction result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me calculate a dilution with these supplied values: {"stock_molarity":2,"target_molarity":0.5,"final_volume_ml":100}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_chemistry_dilution with the supplied inputs. Returns {"stock_volume_ml":25,"bring_to_final_volume_ml":100,"approximate_solvent_ml":75,"formula":"C₁V₁ = C₂V₂","note":"Volume arithmetic only; follow laboratory-specific preparation and safety procedures."}. Shows the actual measurement result. Does not fabricate external data.
